summary: Corrected the ReadIndex membership-filter knowledge entry after re-reading the broadcast path: votingMembers() is the union of remotes and witnesses, so witnesses do receive the hint-carrying heartbeat and their acknowledgements count in both the read and commit quorums (numVotingMembers = len(remotes)+len(witnesses)). The earlier statement had wrongly said witnesses are not addressed. The corrected entry keeps the supported parts — observers receive a heartbeat only with a zero context so they cannot echo a nonzero hint, and a sender outside every role map is dropped by the lw admission lookup before readIndex.confirm runs — and adds two source ranges for the voting-member map and count. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with two source creates and a knowledge update to revision 2 listing statement and source_ids as changed.
